segments.text_en: Emerging of the idea to build a house on Enninu after mentioning flood
evidence: The flood, did it not twinkle? Frightening (all)
I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth
The brick of deciding destinies lifted the head towards him

segments.text_en: Gudea is going to ask for interpretation his divine mother
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant
its ‘heart’ I did not know
may she make its meaning visible for me

segments.text_en: Gudea travels to get divine counseling to make the plan right
evidence: he directed the barge
he sacrificed bread
he went to the king of Bagara, and prayed to him
Hero, charging lion, having no rival
let me do it right
hero in her own right, lady-dream-interpreter of the gods
may she place the path for me

segments.text_en: Gudea provides the ritualistic offerings and prayings to entrench the protection of Nanse in his path
evidence: His (Gudea’s) prayer was being heard
In the House of Bagara he celebrated the week-festival
You have placed my semen in the inside: you bore me in the cella
I will go to the city, may my sign be good
May she stand by me in this case
Let me bring my dream to my mother
may she make its meaning visible for me

segments.text_en: Gudea tells the dream which he is not able to comprehend
evidence: His cry was heard
My Nanše, your word is righteous
You are the dream interpreter of the gods
Inside the dream there was one man
He spoke to me about the building of his house
His ‘heart’ I did not understand
There was one woman. Who was it, who was it not?
She had the tablet of the stars on her lap
Secondly, it was a hero
he drew the plan of the house
a shiny mold was made ready

segments.text_en: Nanse explains the meaning of the dream wih description of funcrions for each entity
evidence: My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you
it is surely my brother Ningirsu
Build his shrine, the Eninnu! He ordered you
it is your god Ningešzida, who like the light went up for you on the horizon
That is surely Nisaba, my sister
she poured out her voice for you
it is Nindubba, placing the house on the plan of the house
in order not to let sweet sleep come to your eyes, (so) that the house is build
that is you, scratching the ground for Eninnu like a choice

segments.text_en: Nanse gives instructions that after making several steps in physical reality Guea can reach the plan of temple
evidence: Let me give give you instructions, let my instructions be heeded
after you have prepared a chariot for your king
after you wrote your name on it
he will receive your small word, as if it was a mighty word
He will reveal the plan of his house to you
he shall let it grow for you

segments.text_en: Gudea follows the instructions, opens his treasury and uses different types of wood to create incense and other stuff
evidence: learnt big, and now he will perform big
To the word Nanše spoke to him, he bowed his head
he brought out wood
He made it straight for him, for the lapis chariot
Joyfully he entered to him in the house
He flattened the hills, he returned accusations
the pure tree of the mountain he placed on the fire
the incense of the gods

segments.text_en: Gudea sensorically interpretates Ningirsu through god's manifestation of the forces of water
evidence: He rose for his king in public, he prayed to him
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you
(but) my sign is my not
I don’t understand its heart
your ‘heart’, surging, like the ocean
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, heart
I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu sends a second dream, the god depicts himself as significant power and promises to give sign and explanation
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house
I will certainly proclaim for you
its -me is bigger than all the other enormous -me
The big fear of my house is spread on all the lands
I, the lord, have made my house, the Eninnu, bigger than a mountain
I will raise my straightened hand to the shiny heaven for abundance
Ningirsu, king, priest of An
it produces poison for me like a poisonous snake

segments.text_en: The promise of abundance made by Ningirsu in case of building the project
evidence: (when) you call the heaven for rain, I will let bounty come to you from the heaven
May people stretch out the hand in bounty with you
The great fields will lift the hand for you
Mounds that are never submerged, will be submerged for you
When you place my platform for me
will straighten a wind for you
at midday the abundance of the sun goes up for you
I will bring ebony for you
I will teach you my sign

segments.text_en: Ritual is provided by Gudea with the gos' instructions: cleaned the city, forbidded accusations and put levy on cities
evidence: He is afraid, it was a dream
He learned big, and now he will perform big
He pruned, he returned accusations
The slave girl, who a man wickedly made into booty
her lady did not thrown stuff in her face
to Gudea, no man brought accusations
The governor cleansed the city
An impure, a terrible one, a leper, he brought out from the city
(For the) platform, he cleanses 24 ‘iku’ of the city for him
he placed a levy

segments.text_en: Neighbours share materials needed for building a temple
evidence: For the construction of Ningirsu’s house, they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu
to Gudea, man, builder of the house
large oaks, ebony, mangrove-wood, to the governor, builder of the Eninnu
He cut down its cedars with the great axe
from the cypress mountain, cypress beams
To the land of stone, where no man enters
made way for him
the copper he excavated there in its excess basket
He will build Eninnu with precious stones, sitting with the stonecutter

segments.text_en: Prohibition for sleeping hours, measuring field for construction by Gudea himself
evidence: he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight
he does not set his head to sleep during midday
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him
Enki made the plan of the house right for him
from high he walked to it, to below, on the platform of fire
the field was right, he measured it
he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself

segments.text_en: Gudea calms himself, gods and neighbours supporting his actions by leading him and taking part in ritual, the emergence of order appears
evidence: calmed his heart
He fixated himself
Utu went up for him in abundance
he sacrificed perfect oxen and perfect goats
Lugalkurdub went in front of him
He greased it with honey, butter oil, and fine butter oil
he made into a paste
The cultic order emerged
The emergence of the brick of the house was placed
Foreigners sprinkle oil with him

segments.text_en: Gods submit the destiny to a brick and Gudea shares this feature with his people
evidence: Utu was pleased with it
King Enki decided its destiny for him
He raised the brick, he brought it to his people
it is the shiny team of Utu shaking its head
it is Nisaba whose heart knows counting
Like a man with (only) little food in the mouth, he is not resting in his walking

segments.text_en: The rehearsal story of a dream that was sent and explained by gods
evidence: a man gave me a good omen
It was placed like something joyful for him
he slept, the word dawned on him
the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, was brought to his attention
He threw the flax, he perfected the me
Enki places the foundation of the house
Nanše, the daughter of Eridu cared for the omen taking
The Annunaki stood there admiring

segments.text_en: Ritual of blessing, iterative process with 7 repetition
evidence: he placed the basket of the house, a shiny crown, on the head
he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house?
They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud
they place the wood in the house
it is a dragon hissing in the mountain

segments.text_en: Ennoblement of a sacred place, adding decorations and developing infrastructure of the temple
evidence: They placed white cedar to be admired in the cedar hall
The E-imdua was decorated with the fertility of Abzu
He planted sweet Asal trees in his city
he stretched out their shadow
He placed the ‘multitude-eraser’, like a great sign, with Lagash

segments.text_en: Gudea install stones and giving them names, manifesting his own relationships with divine entities
evidence: he brought them in a single year, he worked them in a single year
one each day’s work he erected
he placed them in the house
His stone erected in front of the rising sun
as name of that stone he named

segments.text_en: Finalizing the details of construction with emphasizing some sensorical association that it should invoke such as fear or admiring
evidence: He build the house of his king with righteousness
its name until the middle of the mountain
he made emerge
made it stand to be admired
it is the admiring face of the gods
They prepare the meal in the great sanctuary
it is the ‘heart’ of the gods, returned to its banks

segments.text_en: Gudea's seizing and placing important features and entities, and giving names so they're emerge
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea has learned big (things)
and he will perform big (things)
Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram
he seizes there
the seven heroes he seizes there
the emblem of Utu, the head of a bison
he places there
(and) their names, in the midst of the gods
made them emerge

segments.text_en: Further description of decorative installations in the temple and warning do not approach
evidence: They fastened the shiny roof nail in the house
it is a dragon laying hand on a man
the lonely wanderer cannot pass
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands
its inside is a polyphonic song
its outside is a mighty house of abundance rising in heaven
Gudea, in the brilliance of heaven
decorated it

segments.text_en: Food delivery routes and other necessities for the festival
evidence: From the cow pen
oil deliveries, milk deliveries
In the treasury, precious stones, silver, tin
The inner room of harps, (called) ox roaring princely
The tin basin, siding with the storeroom
The fragrant stones standing in the house
it is the house of the purification priests never lacking water
it is the Ekur of Enlil in a festival

segments.text_en: New temple spreads both fear for all lands and praise to its' founders
evidence: The big fear of the house
rests on the land
Its praise reaches the mountains
The fear of Eninnu covers all the lands like a garment
The house (was) built in joy by its king
Gudea, governor of Lagash,  placed its foundation
Temple--going out in the land
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised!
